evidence: The excavation pits, surrounded by dark brown earth tinged with a hint of moss, reveal the secrets of the past. Amidst the quiet atmosphere, tourists carefully contemplate each artifact, immersing themselves in the bustling atmosphere of festivals reenacting ancient royal rituals.
